summary: Butte's St. Patrick's Day celebrations in 1889 include a procession of the Ancient Order of Hibernians, Funeral Guards, and Pinotti Miners watched by crowds, followed by a ball at Miners' Union Hall. The coverage opens with a St. Patrick's Day ode by Catherine Brennan, reprinted from the New York Sun. Patrick J. Murphy serves on the Reception Committee; D. J. Hennessy chairs the Committee of Arrangements and acts as Floor Director; Jas. Murphy appears on the Floor Committee.
